title: fix(runtime): read a delegated MCP token's docs audience against the person's own permission sets
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDxdrYJq965rUfrZBso8FS3)_
Fixes #35584
Clause-②: yes — widening: on a delegated agent token whose scope reaches the docs tools, a permission-set-gated package doc is now found and read when the delegating person holds that set (ADR-0090 D10, ceiling ∩ delegator); nothing served today is refused, a non-holder and a token without docs-tool access still see nothing. Seat runs a contract read before ready; security#2 checks the head read-only before merge.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：用户通过自己的 AI 助手授权登录后，助手能搜到、读到只给某个权限集看的应用手册——前提是本人持有这个权限集，且这次授权包含读数据的范围；其他人和其他手册不变。
- 为什么做：外部 AI 助手接入平台这条线上的遗留问题（应用手册查询的后续）；本人在控制台能看的手册，在自己的助手里却搜不到。
- 出错会怎样：碰到的是通过授权登录使用 AI 助手查手册的人；最坏是该看的手册仍看不到，或权限集手册多给了不持有的人看；改动只在一处读权限的地方，可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

On an OAuth MCP connection the request is an agent acting on behalf of the person who consented (ADR-0090 D10). `search_package_docs` and `read_package_doc` read every page through the `/meta/doc` docs-audience gate; for a manual whose audience is `{ permissionSet }`, the gate asks the security service for the caller's permission-set names. Until now that caller was the agent envelope, whose sets are the token's scope-derived ceiling, so a manual restricted to a set the person holds was neither found nor read on that connection.

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-package-docs.ts`: `packageDocsReadGate` takes the data engine. On a delegated agent envelope (`principalKind: 'agent'` with `onBehalfOf.userId`), the holdings the audience reads are the person's own: `resolveUserAuthzGrants` in the request's organization (`tenantId`), the grant resolution the open draft door uses, without that door's `manage_metadata` admission. It fails closed the way the security plugin's delegator resolution does: no `sys_user` row, no current membership in the organization (`vetOrganizationClaim`), or a read that throws leaves the person with no set, so permission-set audiences stay closed. The envelope's ceiling sets are never read for the audience and never unioned in. Holdings are resolved once per gate, and only when a permission-set audience is in play. A non-delegated principal (session, API key, AI service account) is unchanged.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`: the docs seam rides the bridge only where the grant reaches the docs tools (no grant, or `data:read`). `packageDocToolsServed` in `@objectstack/mcp` stays the authority on listing; the runtime reads the same condition so a token that cannot reach the tools never has the person's holdings read. The bridge call site hands the gate this request's data engine.
- PR #35564's stated limit: the helper header (`mcp-package-docs.ts`) no longer says the envelope's ceiling is the caller, and the test header and the pin are rewritten to match. The pending #35442 changeset is corrected (below). **Not yet adjusted: the two tool descriptions and the registration docblock in `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`** (`registerPackageDocTools`), which still say an OAuth connection is judged on the connection's grant. That file is outside this PR's claimed file surface, so it waits for the claim's amendment; until then this PR stays draft.
- Changeset `.changeset/35584-delegated-docs-audience.md` (`@objectstack/runtime`, patch).

**DELIBERATE CORRECTION** of a pending release note: `.changeset/35442-mcp-app-docs-tools.md` (unreleased). Its sentence about OAuth grants now reads: "On an OAuth grant the request is an agent acting for the person who consented, and a permission-set audience is read against that person's own permission sets (ADR-0090 D10), never the token's scope-derived sets." The dropped sentence ("Both tool descriptions say so.") no longer holds. `check-empty-changeset` is red on this by design; the dispatching seat's record confirms it.

**Pin flipped in place** (`mcp-package-docs.test.ts`): "on an OAuth grant the caller is the agent: the page is neither found nor read though the delegator holds the set" answered CLOSED for a holder; it is replaced by "the holder of the set finds and reads the page", which answers OPEN. Card #35584, maintainer ruling A.

## Ruling conditions

| Condition (ruling A) | Pin in `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-package-docs.test.ts` |
|:--|:--|
| 1. The token's scope must still reach the docs tools. | `a token whose scope does not reach the docs tools is carried no docs member, whatever the person holds` (person holds the set; token `metadata:write` + `actions:execute`; both members absent, scopes passed unchanged to the MCP runtime) |
| 2. Delegator's own holdings by grant resolution; fails closed for a missing person or one outside the organization; never a union; AI service accounts keep their own sets. | `the holder of the set finds and reads the page…`; `fails closed: a person with no user row, or with no membership in the request's organization, holds no set`; `no union: a manual whose audience is a set only the token's ceiling carries stays closed`; `an AI service account keeps its own sets` |
| 3. Keep the non-holder control; a token that cannot reach the docs tools finds and reads nothing. | `control: a person who does not hold the set in the token's organization neither finds nor reads it` (new, OAuth); the session pair `a page only a permission-set manual claims is neither found nor read without the set` / `control: the holder…` kept; the scope pin above |
| 4. security#2 does a read-only check of the head before merge. | Not a code pin: security#2 checks this PR's head read-only before merge. |

Default-audience pages are unchanged: every OAuth pin asserts the default page `crm_order_payment` is still found, including the fail-closed and no-union cases.

## Clause-② reading

Widening only. Nothing served today is refused: the change opens permission-set manuals to a delegated token whose person holds the set and whose scope already reaches the tools. Every answer that was CLOSED for a non-holder stays CLOSED, and a token without `data:read` was already listed neither tool by the MCP runtime, so dropping the seam from its bridge changes nothing it is served.

## Acceptance notes

- Holdings are resolved through `resolveUserAuthzGrants` directly in `mcp-package-docs.ts` rather than via a helper shared with `mcp-authoring.ts`: that file is outside this PR's claimed surface, and its reader is admitted on `manage_metadata`, which the ruling says must not apply here. The two readers now share the grant call, not the admission.
- The scope condition (`data:read`, or no grant) is spelled once more in the runtime beside `packageDocToolsServed`, as the draft door reads `metadata:write` beside `grantsAuthoringTools`. If the MCP runtime's docs family ever changes, both must move.
